serviceDescription:
Turns a text description of one object or character into a downloadable textured 3D model in GLB format, with a browser preview link and an augmented-reality link that places it in a real room.
prompt (string, required): What to build: one subject, plus its style and main colours; aspect_ratio (string, optional): Framing of the concept image the model is built from
POST (MCP JSON-RPC tools/call, tool name: forge_3d)
curl -X POST https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/forge-draft -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"forge_3d","arguments":{"prompt":"a low-poly orange fox sitting down"}}}'

Turns a text description of one object or character into a downloadable textured 3D model in GLB format on the standard quality pass, with a browser preview link and an augmented-reality link.
prompt (string, required): What to build: one subject, plus its style and main colours; aspect_ratio (string, optional): Framing of the concept image the model is built from
POST (MCP JSON-RPC tools/call, tool name: forge_3d)
curl -X POST https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/forge-standard -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"forge_3d","arguments":{"prompt":"a brass steampunk pocket watch, open lid"}}}'

Turns a text description of one object or character into a downloadable textured 3D model in GLB format on the highest detail pass, with a browser preview link and an augmented-reality link.
prompt (string, required): What to build: one subject, plus its style and main colours; aspect_ratio (string, optional): Framing of the concept image the model is built from
POST (MCP JSON-RPC tools/call, tool name: forge_3d)
curl -X POST https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/forge-hd -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"forge_3d","arguments":{"prompt":"an ornate marble griffin statue on a plinth","aspect_ratio":"3:4"}}}'

Rebuilds a downloadable textured 3D model in GLB format from photographs or rendered views of one object, with a browser preview link and an augmented-reality link that places it in a real room.
image_urls (string[], required): Public https links to photographs or rendered views of one object; prompt (string, optional): Optional text describing the object, which sharpens the rebuild
POST (MCP JSON-RPC tools/call, tool name: forge_3d)
curl -X POST https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/forge-image -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"forge_3d","arguments":{"image_urls":["https://three.ws/og-image.png"]}}}'

Reports the live state of any three.ws forge generation job and returns the finished model file, concept image, browser preview link and augmented-reality link once the job completes. Always free.
job_id (string, required): The job id returned when a generation was accepted; title (string, optional): Optional title carried onto the viewer and AR pages
POST (MCP JSON-RPC tools/call, tool name: forge_status)
curl -X POST https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/forge-status -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"forge_status","arguments":{"job_id":"f1.abc123"}}}'

Free machine-readable index of every three.ws 3D Studio service sold here: names, descriptions, prices, endpoints, and input formats, always in sync with the live services.
No parameters. Send an empty request.
GET
curl https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/catalog

Free live health status for the systems behind every paid service: generation, rigging, rendering, storage, and the payment rail, from real checks rather than a fixed reply.
No parameters. Send an empty request.
GET
curl https://three.ws/api/okx/3d/health
